label: Audit of the senses of NECESSARY and the frame-to-schema bridges of the route box
summary: Audit of all fourteen senses of DISAMB-NECESSARY (table in its resolution, 'Sense audit'): every sense with a Lean declaration is a Lean definition with a body or a structure (NECESSARY_11, Modal.Frame); NECESSARY_3 and NECESSARY_4 are defined relative to supplied primitives (the possibility operator and the cause-of-necessity relation); NECESSARY_8 and NECESSARY_10 share the one raw Box operator and differ only in framework premises; NECESSARY_5 (logical necessity, denial contradictory) stays without a declaration by design, since the generic sense does not select a logic, language or interpretation domain, and its bounded instances are NECESSARY_13 to NECESSARY_15 and LogicalNecessityContrast.DenialContradictory. Proved (batch specs/necessary-sense-bridges.toml): the KT route frame premise is logically equivalent to the T schema premise (axiomT_valid forward; the verified StandardCorrespondenceCertificate backward); the KTB frame premise strengthens the B schema premise (axiomB_valid) and the S5 frame premise strengthens the 5 schema premise (axiom5_valid), each strict on the one-world frame without edges. Frontier: the B and 5 schemas stop being open leaves because they are derived from the frame premises; they are not established. Discover rerun with the same 24 targets, premise pool all, 10 candidates (report 20261120T155508Z on the branch; baseline 20261120T134013Z): targets 24, proved 12 -> 12, discoveries 7 -> 3, incompatibilities 2 -> 2, unresolved 12 -> 12, filtered 3 -> 7 (t15 is now known, composed from the new T-to-KT result). The schema targets t18 to t20 remain unresolved for the engine although they are now proved: their declarations bind o : Ontic, the frame premises bind m : Profile, and the engine does not identify o with m.ontic, so its goal quantifies over unrelated o and m and is false.
blocker: Next tests: (1) teach the discovery goal builder, or a carrier tag, that ModalSenseSupport schema statements over o : Ontic are applied at m.ontic, or restate the schema premises over Profile, then rerun t18 to t20; (2) certified differences for the two new strengthens registrations (delta: the KT frame premise; certificate STRONG iff WEAK and KT, needs the B and 5 correspondences of ConvergenceCertificate); (3) the S4 frame to 4 schema order (axiom4_valid) and the frame-to-schema converses for B and 5 combined with T; (4) t7 to t11 (LogicalNecessityProfiles), t13 (NecessaryRootBoxS5), t1, t5 and t2 are untouched. No frame premise or schema is asserted.
